blog.title: Static site, dynamic editing. ⚡️
blog.content:
Just finished building and test-running a custom app to edit my static GitHub Pages site!
It pulls the JSON from GitHub, lets me update the text, and pushes it back. To keep the repo super lightweight, I integrated a slick media workaround: the app uploads any images or videos directly to Giphy, then just saves the URL to display them on the site.
Getting the benefits of a static site with the ease of a CMS. Back to testing! 👨‍💻

blog.title: The Foreman Philosophy
blog.content: Give a man with no knowledge of building a house the best tools, and give a foreman the same tools. Who builds the house? Now, give the foreman a manual saw and the novice an electrical saw. The foreman still wins. My knowledge of structure is what makes me a great developer; AI is simply my power tool.
